nodes.description: Presentation is as a bone tumour more often than a soft tissue one, in adults, with a peak in the third and fourth decades and a male predilection. Simple bone cysts carrying the same fusion arise in the same bones, which is why a fusion result does not settle the diagnosis on its own.

nodes.description: NFATC2 is normally activated by calcineurin in response to calcium signalling, which is how the immune system controls it. The fusion protein retains the active domain but not that control region, so the transcriptional output is no longer conditional. This node covers the NFATC2 stratum only; no equivalent mechanism is recorded here for EWSR1::PATZ1, because the cited literature does not establish one.

nodes.description: Tumours with the NFATC2 fusion form a homogeneous DNA methylation cluster that segregates clearly from Ewing sarcoma and from the CIC and BCOR groups, and they carry recurrent copy number changes: losses on 9q and segmental gains on 20q13 and 22q12 at the two partner loci. This is the strongest single argument that they are not Ewing sarcoma.

evidence.snippet: Unsupervised hierarchical clustering and t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding analysis of DNA methylation data revealed a homogeneous methylation cluster for URCS with EWSR1-NFATc2 fusion, which clearly segregated from EwS and the other subtypes.

nodes.description: A somatic in-frame fusion joining EWSR1, or FUS, to a transcription factor outside the ETS family. In the NFATC2 fusion the breakpoint removes the N-terminal, calcineurin-dependent control region of NFATC2 and leaves its active domain under the EWSR1 transactivation domains. The fusion is accompanied by amplification: the founding study described a ring chromosome and translocation and amplification of regions of 20q13 and 22q12, the NFATC2 and EWSR1 loci.

nodes.description: These tumours are generally treated on Ewing sarcoma protocols, because the category was carved out of Ewing-like sarcoma and nothing has been developed for it. The literature describes the response as poor. No prospective trial has tested a regimen in this entity, and the published series are small enough that the evidence is experience rather than comparison.

evidence.snippet: A recent comprehensive study of round cell sarcomas using high-throughput RNA sequencing identified 5 tumors with EWSR1-PATZ1 (a non-ETS gene) fusion, which on expression profiling clustered away from other EWSR1-fusion positive cases, suggesting a novel tumor entity, one genetically unrelated to other EWRS1 fusion positive round cell sarcomas.

nodes.description: The reported picture is unusual: a more indolent clinical course than Ewing sarcoma, together with poor responsiveness to Ewing-type chemotherapy. Those two are not in tension, but they do mean that outcome here reflects tumour behaviour more than treatment effect. This node records an outcome; no resistance mechanism is established.

nodes.description: Uniform small round or ovoid cells, almost always showing at least focally a growth pattern of nests, cords or trabeculae within a fibrous or myxoid background, often with a variable eosinophilic infiltrate. That architecture, rather than the cytology, is what separates these tumours from Ewing sarcoma on a slide, and it is why they can be mistaken for myoepithelial tumours.
